profile.headline: Software Engineer III
profile.summary: Enthusiastic, goal-oriented Web Developer with 23 years' experience in enterprise-level intranet applications, internet applications and customer support looking for opportunities to build applications using the MERN stack. Quickly adapts to new concepts and technologies and applies them to projects and applications.

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description:
• Skills Used: PHP, HTML, SQL, MySQL, & JavaScript, WordPress, & CSS
• Create and maintain the Sensory Data Management system. The Sensory Data Management system is a Wordpress plugin used to store sensory data as it relates to businesses that have been evaluated through the Twenty-One Senses Sensory Scout program. 
• Maintain organization website (www.twentyonesenses.org) by ensuring Wordpress and installed plugins are kept up-to-date. 
• Evaluate plugins and new software against desired requirements to fully vet any new plugins or software for organization's web presence.
• Build and maintain 12+ process automations implemented through Zapier by analyzing the business needs prior to connecting the required systems, testing, and launching.
• Flexibly and consistently contribute to organization goals by juggling multiple duties from full website to single page creation

positions.title: Web Developer, Sr
positions.description:
• Skills Used: ColdFusion, HTML, JavaScript, JSON, JQuery, SQL, Oracle, XML, AJAX, & CSS 
• Worked as part of a development team to maintain and enhance in-house web content management system. 
• Ensured compliance with software quality assurance best practices through consistently implementing standards throughout all lifecycle stages.
• Collaborated with multiple cross-functional teams on various enhancement projects to execute requirements gathering, scoping, system architecture design, development, testing, and deployment.

positions.title: Web Developer, Sr.
positions.description:
• Skills Used: ColdFusion, HTML, JavaScript, JSON, JQuery, SQL, Oracle, XML, AJAX, & CSS 
• Worked as part of a development team to maintain and enhance in-house web content management system. 
• Ensured compliance with software quality assurance best practices through consistently implementing standards throughout all lifecycle stages.
• Collaborated with multiple cross-functional teams on various enhancement projects to execute requirements gathering, scoping, system architecture design, development, testing, and deployment. 
• Maintained existing internet sites, including enhancements, troubleshooting and problem resolution; 
• Created landing pages and email campaigns as needed to meet marketing goals. 
• Created online registration system for company institutes and workshops including registration forms, automated follow-up email campaigns, and reporting tool for the Enrollment Support group.
• Implemented a system to automate testing of landing pages for effectiveness with regards to user response.
• Implemented a system to automate data entry of all master's program web leads into SalesLogix.
• Actively contributed to team receiving 2007 Beacon Award for www.teacher-degrees.com website.

educations.schoolName: Missouri University of Science and Technology

projects.title: Bongo
projects.description:
• Bongo is a MERN app that gives small businesses the tools/resources to create a simple website without a developer. The proof of concept for this app focused on creating a menu website for restaurants. 
• Skills Used: React, MongoDB, Express, Node, JSON, HTML, & CSS
• Created and built products model, products endpoints, product components,authentication functionality.
